title: Voyager golden record carrying the Navajo Night Chant

tellings.quote: Each spacecraft carried what was known as a golden record containing the sights and sounds of planet Earth.

plain: When the two Voyager spacecraft were launched in 1977, each one carried a golden record "containing the sights and sounds of planet Earth", and among those sounds was the Navajo Night Chant. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and uses it to point out that a Native American ceremony is now travelling through interstellar space.
